tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Aisha.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 2 people, 27 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 5 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the southwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.

The southwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the southwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Peter.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table III is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Elena.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table III. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~1200 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table III bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table III. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
You don't know what that was. An inflatable rat the size of a house. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
A runner from The Red Table III, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Leo speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You give Emberhold 1,995 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Fatima weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table III bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~600 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

At the fire, someone does the math out loud — the pods' life-support draw, against the pantry. "I'm just saying. That power could be food." Nobody looks at the mourners. Everybody knows where the mourners are sitting.
(Defend the pods — it will cost real food — or let the question hang.)
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
